newsitem.title: UK: Russian seaborne April crude exports surge - Petra.
newsitem.headline: Russian seaborne April crude exports surge - Petra.

text.p: Russian seaborne crude exports jumped 22 percent, or 237,000 barrels per day (bpd) in April due to a sharp rise in shipments from the Black Sea ports of Novorossiisk and Odessa, shipping inspectors Petrak said on Thursday.
Crude exports from the four ports, including Tuapse and the Baltic port of Ventspils, totalled 1.296 million bpd, 237,000 bpd more than in March, Petrak said.
Seaborne exports in the first four months of the year averaged 1.180 million bpd.
Russia's leading port of Novorossiisk shipped 657,741 bpd in April, against 501,309 bpd in March, a 31 percent rise.
Odessa shipped 244,181 bpd, 74,796 bpd up on March, while Tuapse exports were broadly steady at 92,215 bpd.
April crude exports from the Latvian port of Ventspils totalled 302,295 bpd, slightly higher than March's 293,337 bpd.
